body: I think [Heroku provides that out of the box](https://devcenter.heroku.com/articles/github-integration-review-apps). Not sure if this will work for you. We have this kind of solution even before Heroku has launched it. Using a single Apache wildcard vhost and an internal tool to listen to GitHub PRs and create a staging env for the branch - https://github.com/clippings/robot Before that we were using Docker containers for each branch, but it turned out to be quite a hassle.
